annotations.title: Read a Client Hub page as text

description: Fetch a read page of a Jobber Client Hub — `appointments`, `invoices`, `quotes` or `work_requests`, optionally with a numeric id — and return its readable text. Use for detail pages (e.g. `invoices/150208512`, `appointments/2236612358`) whose layout has no pinned schema, and to inspect a page when a list tool returns nothing. Other hub routes (logout, forms, payment pages) are refused. Read-only.

hub.description: Which provider hub to read, by label. Omit when only one is configured.

path.description: Hub-relative read path: "appointments", "invoices", "quotes" or "work_requests", optionally with a numeric id, e.g. "invoices/150208512".

name: jobber_read_page
title: Read a Client Hub page as text
